QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] What's in a Name?
QuestInfo.0: The Temple Keeper seemed to understand the Record Keeper's message.
QuestInfo.1: Let the Amnesiac Temple Keeper know that you can't help him out.
QuestInfo.2:
You went to the Amnesiac Temple Keeper to tell them they need to recover their memory on their own, but they said the Tinglebrain Potion had some effect.
It's vague but they feel like memory fragments are floating inside their head.
They revealed their face behind the hood and told you their name, thanking you for helping so far.
But their face is...

0.0: I suppose there's nothing we can do. Thanks for trying... \r\n#L0##bWhat did he mean, 'he lost his own time'?#l\n#k
0.1: I'm afraid I'm not totally sure, but it makes me wonder if I haven't been wrong about him this whole time. I always thought he was a vagrant who wandered in here, but now I wonder if he didn't come THROUGH the Gate of the Past... \r\n#L0##bYou mean... the Amnesiac Temple Keeper is from a different time?!#l\n#k
0.2: I don't know any more than that. Please go tell the Amnesiac Temple Keeper about how you tried to help. I think it will make him feel better...

yes.0: Try to let him down easy, will you?

1.0: You're back! I have so much to tell you!\r\n#L0##bListen, I'm sorry, but... There's just nothing else I can...#l\n#k
1.1: I think the Tinglebrain Potion worked! I keep getting glimpses of my past... I remember following a masked man when he was battling monsters. I THINK I hid some kind of a map in this big library. I feel like... I feel like all my memories will come back. I even remember my name!\r\n#L0##bThat's great! Tell me your name!#l\n#k

yes.0: It's weird to say it after all this time... it feels strange. M-my name is #e#bKao#k#n! That's who I am. That's who I was...
